title: Pick Me Up, Infinite Gacha
altTitles: PICK ME UP～低レア★英雄の成り上がり～
PICK ME UP～低レア英雄の成り上がり～
ピックミーアップ！低レア英雄の成り上がり
description: The mobile gacha game Pick Me Up! is infamous for its extreme difficulty, with no one having successfully cleared its dungeons. Loki, the fifth-ranked Master in the world, loses consciousness while attempting to clear a dungeon and awakens inside the game as Han Yslat, a Level 1, 1-Star Hero. To return to Earth, Loki must lead inexperienced Masters and heroes through the dungeon and reach the 100th floor without suffering a single defeat.
author: Hermod / U-Ne Cho / Wasakbasak
